sync_menu_pair.context: Menu item when not paired (also unpaired in the browser): opens the pairing. One plain line, no subtitle (owner 2026-11-07)

sync_menu_paired.context: Menu item when paired: opens Settings → Browser sync (status, Unpair). One plain line, no ✓, no subtitle (owner 2026-11-07)

sync_menu_browser.context: In the grey line "Pixel 8 ↔ browser · 1 min ago" when the browser has not said its name yet

sync_menu_full.context: Amber second line of the sync item: the mailbox is full (507)

sync_menu_refused.context: Amber second line of the sync item: the server refused the last pass

sync_menu_storage.context: Amber second line of the sync item: the phone could not write its sync files

sync_menu_ended.context: Amber second line of "Pair with browser": the pairing was ended in the browser (until Browser sync is opened)

sync_menu_stale.context: Amber second line of the sync item: online and paired, but no good sync for more than 6 hours

sync_menu_unpaired_browser.context: Grey second line under "Pair with browser" (and the line on the Browser sync page): the user unpaired in the browser, the phone still has its pairing – scanning a new code pairs again

sync_waiting_browser.context: Grey second line under "Paired with browser" (no ✓) and on the Browser sync page: paired, but the scanned browser has not answered yet (field bug 2026-10-31: never "connected" before)

sync_menu_synced.context: In the grey line "Pixel 8 ↔ Chrome on Linux · synced 1 min ago": %1$s = sync_ago_* or a time; the PHONE's own last good sync, not when the browser was seen

sync_intro.context: First line of the page when not paired

sync_steps.context: How to pair: the web planner's header button is "Pair phone" (the German web text must match)
sync_steps.doubt: Must match the web planner's German header button text

sync_open_camera.context: Button: opens the phone's camera app (it reads the QR code)

sync_no_camera.context: Red line when no camera app opens

sync_ask_title.context: Question after a pairing code was scanned (with Pair / Cancel)

sync_paired_plan.context: Strip at the top of the Plan map right after Pair succeeded (first pairing or another browser; the app goes back to the Plan screen), with OK, stays until OK (owner 2026-10-30); the web planner shows the same text after pairing

sync_paired_with.context: %1$s = the browser's name, e.g. "Chrome on Linux" (also the Settings list line)

sync_paired_browser.context: Paired, the browser has not said its name yet

sync_ago_now.context: In "Last synced: %1$s": the last good sync was less than a minute ago

sync_ago_min.context: In "Last synced: %1$s": %1$d = minutes (1–59) since the last good sync; later the time ("today 18:40")

sync_unpair.context: Button (asks first) and the dialog's confirm button

sync_unpaired_plan.context: Strip at the top of the Plan map right after Unpair (the app goes back to the Plan screen from Settings), with OK, stays until OK (owner 2026-10-30)

sync_unpaired_plan_offline.context: The same strip when the sync server could not be reached: unpaired on the phone only, the browser must be unpaired there too

sync_refused.context: Amber line. %1$s = HTTP status and the server's short English reason

sync_full.context: Amber line: the mailbox limit (1000 items / 4 MB) is reached

sync_stuck.context: Amber line: routes stayed unsent for 3 sync passes. %1$d = count

sync_already_paired.context: Grey line: the same code scanned again

sync_join_offline.context: Red line: Pair with another browser while this phone is paired (A-017: the phone sends that browser into its mailbox) – no connection

sync_join_used.context: Red line: the scanned code of another browser is used up (its mailbox ended)

sync_join_failed.context: Red line: the server refused pairing another browser

sync_copy.context: Word in brackets after a route kept as a copy when phone and browser changed it at the same time: Waalweg (copy)

sync_link_broken.context: Red line: a cut-off / unknown pairing code

sync_during_tour.context: Grey line while a tour records: the pairing is made (the browser sees the phone), the saved routes sync when the tour has ended

sync_untitled_route.context: Name of a route from the browser without a name

sync_untitled_track.context: Name of a track from the browser without a name

sync_sum_off.context: Line under the topic "Browser sync" when not paired

sync_menu_attention.context: Screen-reader text of the amber sync menu item: "Browser pairing – <reason>"

sync_last_label.context: Row title; its value is a time ("10:12", "gestern 09:12") or sync_last_never

sync_last_never.context: Value of "Last synced" before the first good pass

sync_planner_label.context: Row title; its value is the planner's address plan.onpath.earth
